title: Review project or portfolio health (read-only)
description: Use when a read-only health, status, risk or integrity review of an LPM project or portfolio is asked (saúde, revisão semanal, 'what needs my attention'). Names the fixing skill per finding; never edits. Not for fixes (use lpm-plan-work) or unowned capabilities (use lpm-executive-context).
doneWhen: A report exists where every number comes from a tool result of this run and every finding names the skill that fixes it.
authorityCeiling: Read-only: this skill owns no write tool (validator-enforced).
jobs: o que precisa da minha atenção no portfólio?
relatório de status semanal do workspace
list the risks of this project and the skill that fixes each one
is this project really healthy? check the integrity signals

notFor.when: fixing overdue, unassigned or unestimated work, or a stale cycle
fixing a blocked activity or a dependency
scope drift, orphan requirements, change sets or baselines
orphan AISH jobs or job/activity mismatches

references.loadWhen: read-only compatibility inventory of project agent runs and checkpoints before a recovery release
playbook project: health, status, risks or weekly review of one project or cycle, with an LPM API key
playbook connector: review of one project on a ChatGPT/Claude connector, or when playbook project hit -32003
playbook portfolio: portfolio or workspace review, "what needs my attention", or a weekly review of a whole workspace
playbook changes: owner-agent snapshot of a workspace, or "what changed since version <v>", with an LPM API key
background for maintainers: how LPM computes each health status (the playbooks already hold every rule they need)

codex.shortDescription: Read-only LPM project and portfolio health review
codex.defaultPrompt: Use $lpm-review-health to review the health of LPM project <projectId>.
